PR04: address headless inspector state review threads

- Bind field mutations to the snapshot's target element id; retained
  callbacks no-op once a different element is selected or the controller
  is disposed
- Preserve custom plugin sections in the public headless state via
  PlateCustomInspectorSectionState (default/headless parity)
- Freeze all public snapshot collections (sections, selectedElementIds,
  binding options, table cells/maps) through factory constructors
- Add regression tests for all three threads
